patterns.note: Sections feature a playful, scrapbook-like arrangement of product cutouts and sticker-style illustrations, breaking from rigid grid structures.
Dominant use of an extremely bold, rounded, and cartoonish display font for main headings, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels.
A vibrant and high-contrast palette centered on a soft pink background, accented by bright blues, purples, and reds, with stark black typography.

The hero section features subtle parallax scrolling where the main character and sun graphic move at a slightly different speed than the background. Subsequent content sections reveal with a staggered fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport.
Product displays are presented as 'cutout' images with soft, irregular shadows, giving them a sticker-like appearance against the background.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-driven animation system (likely locomotive-scroll) to create a dynamic experience. This includes a subtle parallax effect on hero elements, where foreground graphics move slower than the background during scroll. Additionally, content sections and individual elements within them are revealed with a staggered fade-up or slide-in motion as they scroll into view.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to links while the page content scrolls beneath it.
Product images are rendered as transparent cutouts with a soft, irregular drop shadow, making them appear as if they are physical stickers placed on the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, very bold, rounded display headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle for buttons and some containers, but many graphic elements are organically rounded or have irregular, hand-drawn edges.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, particularly in the hero and between major sections, creating a relaxed and open feel, while product grids maintain balanced padding.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly playful and illustrative aesthetic, combining bold, cartoonish typography with sticker-like product cutouts and animated character graphics. This creates a unique, almost scrapbook-like visual experience that feels energetic and youthful, moving far beyond a typical e-commerce layout.
